description: What happened in the last week that you should know: a store's review answer (App Review, Google Play), a build that failed or reached testers, an approval the person decided, a person's task done, something a store turned down, a low review, a TestFlight build about to expire, a store connection that stopped working. Each with what to do next. New ones also come at the end of any Ploa tool's answer, once; call this at the start of the work, and when the person asks what's new.
